messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: latest version of rstan?
parts:
Hi, on the Stan webpage (http://mc-stan.org/documentation/) it says:

• Modeling Language User's Guide and Reference Manual, Version 2.10.0
(GitHub pdf, CC-BY 4.0 license)

• If you are using RStan/PyStan v2.9.0 (the current version), download this manual:
Modeling Language User's Guide and Reference Manual, Version 2.9.0
(GitHub pdf, CC-BY 4.0 license)

But on my computer it seems that I have Rstan 2.10, at least that's what it says in Rstudio when I do ?rstan.

Which is correct? I think we are in 2.10 and the webpage just needs to be updated, but I wanted to be sure.

Thx
A

are released asynchronously. PyStan is still at 2.9,
but the other interfaces are at 2.10.
